story: Type 2 on long-acting insulin and metformin; pregnant (fictional flag). Changed from type 1 because the dataset has no young woman with type 1.

regimen.note: Summarized from the dataset subject's dose records. Read back only; never sent to the model. Not clinical guidance.

data_source.name: ShanghaiT1DM and ShanghaiT2DM
data_source.citation: Zhao Q, Zhu J, Shen X, et al. Chinese diabetes datasets for data-driven machine learning. Scientific Data 10, 35 (2023).
data_source.changes: Timestamps re-anchored so the last reading falls at load time; window trimmed to end shortly after the scenario's key event (at most 14 days); regimen summarized from the subject's dose records; name, clinic history, and profile flags are fictional.
